# Miguel Herrera — Plant Manager, Toledo

- **Relationship:** runs the **Toledo, OH** valve plant (~180 people); reports up through COO
  [Sandra Kim](sandra-kim.md). Joined Brandt in 2018.
- **Cadence:** on the daily 07:15 production call; monthly plant walk.
- **Distinguishing fact:** Toledo is the oldest site and lowest-OEE at **63%**; aging equipment
  and a thin order book.
- **Under review:** the Toledo footprint decision is tracked confidentially as
  [Slate](../projects/slate.md). **Miguel is not yet cleared** into Slate — do not discuss the
  footprint decision with or around him.

## How to work with him
- Loyal and well-liked on the floor; has fought hard to keep Toledo's numbers up.
- Deserves a straight, humane conversation when the footprint decision is made.

## Sensitivities
- **Not cleared** on Slate; any footprint discussion stays confidential until the board decides.
